Services

Rapid Restore is your trusted partner for all your construction, renovation, and restoration needs in Calgary, Alberta.

Explore

Fire Damage Restoration

Learn More Rapid Restore's fire damage restoration division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive restoration of properties affected by fire and smoke. Our team of certified technicians employs advanced cleaning and restoration techniques to mitigate structural damage, eliminate smoke odors, and salvage personal belongings. Learn More

Hail Damage Restoration

Learn More Rapid Restore's hail damage restoration division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive repair and restoration of properties affected by hailstorms. Our expert team conducts thorough roof, siding, and window inspections to assess the extent of damage. Learn More

Water Damage Restoration

Learn More Rapid Restore's hail damage restoration division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive repair and restoration of properties affected by hailstorms. Our expert team conducts thorough roof, siding, and window inspections to assess the extent of damage. Learn More

Condominium Restoration

Learn More Maximize Your Condo’s Potential with Rapid Restore. Transform your Calgary condo into a luxurious retreat. Rapid Restore specializes in condo renovations, navigating the unique challenges of condo living. Learn More

Residential Restoration

Learn More Rapid Restore is your trusted partner for all your construction, renovation, and restoration needs in Calgary, Alberta. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service, quality craftsmanship, and timely project completion. Learn More

Commercial Restoration

Learn More When disaster strikes your Calgary commercial property, Rapid Response Restoration is your trusted partner for swift and efficient restoration services. Our team of experienced professionals is dedicated to minimizing downtime and financial loss, restoring your business to its pre-loss condition. Learn More

Project management

With Rapid Restore, you can sit back and relax knowing your project is in the best hands. Our expert project management team handles every detail, ensuring your restoration, renovation, or new construction goes smoothly from start to finish. You'll have a single point of contact to keep you updated on progress, handle any challenges that arise, and make sure you're completely satisfied with the final result.

Book Appointment

General contracting

Rapid Restore's general contracting team in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive management of construction projects, delivering exceptional results through a meticulous focus on key performance indicators (KPIs). Our team of seasoned professionals excels in project coordination, cost estimation, and scheduling, utilizing advanced project management tools to optimize resource allocation and ensure timely project milestones. We maintain rigorous quality control measures, backed by a deep understanding of building codes and industry best practices. Our commitment to open communication and collaboration with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers fosters strong partnerships and drives successful project outcomes. With a proven track record of achieving client satisfaction and exceeding industry benchmarks, Rapid Restore is the preferred choice for general contracting services in Calgary.

Book Appointment

Remodeling exterior/interior

Rapid Restore's remodeling division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive transformation of residential and commercial spaces, utilizing a scientific approach to project planning and execution. Our team employs advanced design software to create detailed architectural renderings and virtual walkthroughs, allowing clients to visualize the final outcome. We conduct thorough site assessments to identify potential structural, electrical, and plumbing complexities, ensuring a seamless remodeling process. Our skilled craftsmen utilize high-quality materials and precision techniques to achieve exceptional results in areas such as kitchen and bathroom renovations, additions, and exterior upgrades. We adhere to strict quality control measures and building codes to ensure the longevity and safety of the remodeled space.

Book Appointment

Roofing

Does your roof need a Rapid Restore? We're Calgary, Alberta's roofing experts, specializing in repairs for all types of roofs. From simple asphalt shingle replacements to complex metal roof restorations, our skilled team has the knowledge and experience to tackle any job. We use only the highest quality materials and back our work with a strong warranty. When you choose Rapid Restore, you're choosing peace of mind and a roof that will last.

Book Appointment

Siding/vinyl / Stucco/brick

Rapid Restore offers advanced siding solutions in Calgary, Alberta, utilizing cutting-edge techniques for vinyl, stucco, and brick installations. Our team is well-versed in the specific properties of each material, ensuring optimal performance, durability, and aesthetic appeal. Whether it's the low-maintenance benefits of vinyl, the customizable nature of stucco, or the classic elegance of brick, we deliver superior results backed by our commitment to quality craftsmanship."

Book Appointment

Drywall

Our Calgary drywall experts deliver precise and efficient installations using moisture-resistant boards where needed. We ensure proper screw spacing, joint taping with high-quality mesh, and finishing compounds for a flawless surface. Our attention to detail creates a solid foundation for your interior walls and ceilings.

Book Appointment

Mudding taping

Rapid Restore's drywall finishing team specializes in the application of joint compounds and taping to create smooth, seamless transitions between drywall panels. Our process involves precise mixing of joint compound, proper tape embedment, and meticulous sanding techniques to achieve flawless surfaces ready for paint or texture.

Book Appointment

Painting exterior/interior

Rapid Restore offers advanced painting solutions in Calgary, utilizing premium paints and primers meticulously selected for specific substrates and environmental conditions. Our skilled painters employ precise application techniques, including proper masking, surface preparation, and multiple coats to achieve optimal adhesion, durability, and a flawless finish. We stay up-to-date with the latest industry standards and technologies to deliver superior results that exceed our clients' expectations.

Book Appointment

Carpentry

Rapid Restore's carpentry division in Calgary excels in the precision engineering and construction of wood-based systems. We offer a comprehensive range of services, including structural analysis and reinforcement, custom millwork fabrication with advanced machinery, and meticulous finish carpentry that adheres to strict quality standards.

Book Appointment

Electrical

Rapid Restore's electrical division in Calgary specializes in the design, installation, and maintenance of safe and efficient electrical systems. Our team of licensed electricians possesses in-depth knowledge of electrical codes and standards, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment and techniques to deliver precise and reliable solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial clients.

Book Appointment

Plumbing

Rapid Restore's plumbing division in Calgary offers comprehensive solutions for residential and commercial plumbing systems. Our licensed plumbers specialize in the installation, repair, and maintenance of water supply lines, drainage systems, fixtures, and appliances. Utilizing advanced diagnostic tools and techniques, we provide efficient and effective services to restore optimal plumbing functionality and prevent costly water damage.

Book Appointment

Concrete Services

Driveways

Our team specializes in concrete driveway installations engineered to withstand Calgary's extreme weather cycles. We utilize advanced concrete formulations reinforced with steel fibers for exceptional durability and resistance to cracking and deformation. Our precise installation techniques include proper sub-base preparation, controlled compaction, and consistent curing processes to optimize the concrete's strength and longevity.

Book Appointment

Sidewalks

Our team specializes in concrete sidewalk installations engineered for optimal pedestrian traffic and load distribution. We utilize high-strength concrete formulations with controlled slump and air entrainment for enhanced durability and resistance to freeze-thaw cycles. Our precise installation process includes establishing accurate grades, reinforced base layers, and controlled curing to meet stringent city codes and ensure long-lasting performance.

Book Appointment

Steps

Our team specializes in the structural engineering and construction of concrete steps designed for optimal load-bearing capacity and safety. We utilize advanced concrete design software to calculate precise reinforcement requirements and pour dimensions. Our installation process emphasizes accurate formwork placement, vibration compaction, and controlled curing to achieve the highest standards of quality and durability.

Book Appointment

Foundation

Our team specializes in the engineering and construction of concrete foundations designed to provide exceptional structural support for residential and commercial buildings. We utilize advanced soil analysis and load-bearing calculations to determine optimal foundation depth, width, and reinforcement requirements. Our precise formwork and rebar placement, combined with high-quality concrete mixtures and controlled curing processes, ensure the creation of foundations that meet stringent building codes and provide long-term stability.

Book Appointment

Patching

Our team specializes in concrete repair solutions, utilizing advanced crack injection techniques and high-strength epoxy materials to restore structural integrity and prevent further damage. We conduct thorough assessments to determine the underlying cause of cracks and employ precise repair methods, including surface preparation, crack cleaning, and controlled material application to ensure long-lasting results.

Book Appointment

Get In Touch

REQUEST A FREE PROJECT ESTIMATE

For an obligation-free consultation regarding your home renovation needs, please share your details with us using the contact form below. At Rapid Restore, our expert team, led by a commitment to "restoration with excellence," offers a comprehensive range of services. From design and planning to approvals, demolition, and construction, we provide a full-cycle restoration service to bring your vision to life. Let us help you restore your property to its best condition.

Commercial Restoration

Our Process

When disaster strikes your Calgary commercial property, Rapid Response Restoration is your trusted partner for swift and efficient restoration services. Our team of experienced professionals is dedicated to minimizing downtime and financial loss, restoring your business to its pre-loss condition. Our comprehensive services include water damage restoration, fire damage restoration, mold remediation, and reconstruction, all performed with meticulous attention to detail and adherence to industry best practices. We work closely with insurance adjusters to streamline the claims process and ensure you receive the maximum compensation for your losses.

Our goal is to not only restore your property but also to provide peace of mind throughout the entire restoration process.

Book Appointment

Why Work With Us?

Choosing the right partner for your home renovation is crucial, and we understand the significance of your decision. Here's why working with us is the best choice for your project:

Expert
craftsmanship

Rapid Restore's commitment to craftsmanship is evident in every project we undertake. Our skilled artisans and technicians possess a deep-rooted passion for their trade, utilizing time-honored techniques alongside the latest industry advancements. We take pride in delivering exceptional results that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring that every detail is meticulously executed with precision and care.

Customer-center
Approach

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional customer experiences throughout every stage of the project. We prioritize open communication, active listening, and understanding our clients' unique needs and preferences. By fostering strong relationships built on trust and reliability, we ensure that our clients feel valued and supported throughout the entire process.

Comprehensive
services

Rapid Restore offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. From initial consultations and project planning to expert execution and ongoing maintenance, we provide a seamless and integrated approach to ensure exceptional results. Our team possesses a wide range of expertise, allowing us to handle projects of varying complexity and scope. By offering a one-stop solution for multiple services, we streamline the project process, minimize inconvenience for our clients, and deliver exceptional value.

Excellent Value
Affordable services

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional value and affordability without compromising on quality. We offer competitive pricing, transparent cost estimates, and efficient project management to maximize the return on investment for our clients. Our team explores innovative cost-saving strategies and sources high-performance materials at optimal prices, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible value for their hard-earned money without sacrificing quality or functionality.

BOOK a FREE virtual CONSULTATION

Call 403 971-7984 BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Get In Touch

REQUEST A FREE PROJECT ESTIMATE

For an obligation-free consultation regarding your home renovation needs, please share your details with us using the contact form below. At Rapid Restore, our expert team, led by a commitment to "restoration with excellence," offers a comprehensive range of services. From design and planning to approvals, demolition, and construction, we provide a full-cycle restoration service to bring your vision to life. Let us help you restore your property to its best condition.

Residential Restoration

Book Appointment Years Of Experience 0 + Satisfied Clients 0 + Projects completed 0 k+ Team Members 0 +

Our Process

Rapid Restore is your trusted partner for all your construction, renovation, and restoration needs in Calgary, Alberta. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service, quality craftsmanship, and timely project completion. Our team of skilled professionals is equipped to handle a wide range of projects, from minor repairs to major renovations. Whether you’re dealing with the aftermath of a disaster or simply looking to improve your property, we’re here to help.

Our focus on customer satisfaction ensures that your project is completed to the highest standards. With Rapid Restore, you can rest assured that your property is in good hands.

Book Appointment

Why Work With Us?

Choosing the right partner for your home renovation is crucial, and we understand the significance of your decision. Here's why working with us is the best choice for your project:

Expert
craftsmanship

Rapid Restore's commitment to craftsmanship is evident in every project we undertake. Our skilled artisans and technicians possess a deep-rooted passion for their trade, utilizing time-honored techniques alongside the latest industry advancements. We take pride in delivering exceptional results that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring that every detail is meticulously executed with precision and care.

Customer-center
Approach

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional customer experiences throughout every stage of the project. We prioritize open communication, active listening, and understanding our clients' unique needs and preferences. By fostering strong relationships built on trust and reliability, we ensure that our clients feel valued and supported throughout the entire process.

Comprehensive
services

Rapid Restore offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. From initial consultations and project planning to expert execution and ongoing maintenance, we provide a seamless and integrated approach to ensure exceptional results. Our team possesses a wide range of expertise, allowing us to handle projects of varying complexity and scope. By offering a one-stop solution for multiple services, we streamline the project process, minimize inconvenience for our clients, and deliver exceptional value.

Excellent Value
Affordable services

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional value and affordability without compromising on quality. We offer competitive pricing, transparent cost estimates, and efficient project management to maximize the return on investment for our clients. Our team explores innovative cost-saving strategies and sources high-performance materials at optimal prices, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible value for their hard-earned money without sacrificing quality or functionality.

BOOK a FREE virtual CONSULTATION

Call 403 971-7984 BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Get In Touch

REQUEST A FREE PROJECT ESTIMATE

For an obligation-free consultation regarding your home renovation needs, please share your details with us using the contact form below. At Rapid Restore, our expert team, led by a commitment to "restoration with excellence," offers a comprehensive range of services. From design and planning to approvals, demolition, and construction, we provide a full-cycle restoration service to bring your vision to life. Let us help you restore your property to its best condition.

Our Process

Maximize Your Condo’s Potential with Rapid Restore

Transform your Calgary condo into a luxurious retreat. Rapid Restore specializes in condo renovations, navigating the unique challenges of condo living. Our team is adept at working within condo board regulations and building codes to deliver stunning results. From sleek, modern designs to cozy, traditional aesthetics, we can customize your space to reflect your personal style. Let us help you create a condo you’ll love coming home to.

Book Appointment

Why Work With Us?

Choosing the right partner for your home renovation is crucial, and we understand the significance of your decision. Here's why working with us is the best choice for your project:

Expert
craftsmanship

Rapid Restore's commitment to craftsmanship is evident in every project we undertake. Our skilled artisans and technicians possess a deep-rooted passion for their trade, utilizing time-honored techniques alongside the latest industry advancements. We take pride in delivering exceptional results that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring that every detail is meticulously executed with precision and care.

Customer-center
Approach

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional customer experiences throughout every stage of the project. We prioritize open communication, active listening, and understanding our clients' unique needs and preferences. By fostering strong relationships built on trust and reliability, we ensure that our clients feel valued and supported throughout the entire process.

Comprehensive
services

Rapid Restore offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. From initial consultations and project planning to expert execution and ongoing maintenance, we provide a seamless and integrated approach to ensure exceptional results. Our team possesses a wide range of expertise, allowing us to handle projects of varying complexity and scope. By offering a one-stop solution for multiple services, we streamline the project process, minimize inconvenience for our clients, and deliver exceptional value.

Excellent Value
Affordable services

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional value and affordability without compromising on quality. We offer competitive pricing, transparent cost estimates, and efficient project management to maximize the return on investment for our clients. Our team explores innovative cost-saving strategies and sources high-performance materials at optimal prices, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible value for their hard-earned money without sacrificing quality or functionality.

BOOK a FREE virtual CONSULTATION

Call 403 971-7984 BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Get In Touch

REQUEST A FREE PROJECT ESTIMATE

For an obligation-free consultation regarding your home renovation needs, please share your details with us using the contact form below. At Rapid Restore, our expert team, led by a commitment to "restoration with excellence," offers a comprehensive range of services. From design and planning to approvals, demolition, and construction, we provide a full-cycle restoration service to bring your vision to life. Let us help you restore your property to its best condition.

Water Damage Restoration

Book Appointment Years Of Experience 0 + Satisfied Clients 0 + Projects completed 0 k+ Team Members 0 +

Our Process

Rapid Restore's hail damage restoration division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive repair and restoration of properties affected by hailstorms. Our expert team conducts thorough roof, siding, and window inspections to assess the extent of damage. Utilizing advanced repair techniques and high-quality materials, we meticulously restore individual shingles, replace damaged siding panels, and repair or replace broken windows. Our skilled technicians address issues such as granule loss, impact fractures, and dents, ensuring the restoration of the roof's protective barrier and the overall aesthetic appeal of the property. We work closely with insurance adjusters to expedite the claims process and provide clients with exceptional customer service throughout the restoration journey.

Book Appointment

Why Work With Us?

Choosing the right partner for your home renovation is crucial, and we understand the significance of your decision. Here's why working with us is the best choice for your project:

Expert
craftsmanship

Rapid Restore's commitment to craftsmanship is evident in every project we undertake. Our skilled artisans and technicians possess a deep-rooted passion for their trade, utilizing time-honored techniques alongside the latest industry advancements. We take pride in delivering exceptional results that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring that every detail is meticulously executed with precision and care.

Customer-center
Approach

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional customer experiences throughout every stage of the project. We prioritize open communication, active listening, and understanding our clients' unique needs and preferences. By fostering strong relationships built on trust and reliability, we ensure that our clients feel valued and supported throughout the entire process.

Comprehensive
services

Rapid Restore offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. From initial consultations and project planning to expert execution and ongoing maintenance, we provide a seamless and integrated approach to ensure exceptional results. Our team possesses a wide range of expertise, allowing us to handle projects of varying complexity and scope. By offering a one-stop solution for multiple services, we streamline the project process, minimize inconvenience for our clients, and deliver exceptional value.

Excellent Value
Affordable services

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional value and affordability without compromising on quality. We offer competitive pricing, transparent cost estimates, and efficient project management to maximize the return on investment for our clients. Our team explores innovative cost-saving strategies and sources high-performance materials at optimal prices, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible value for their hard-earned money without sacrificing quality or functionality.

BOOK a FREE virtual CONSULTATION

Call 403 971-7984 BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Get In Touch

REQUEST A FREE PROJECT ESTIMATE

For an obligation-free consultation regarding your home renovation needs, please share your details with us using the contact form below. At Rapid Restore, our expert team, led by a commitment to "restoration with excellence," offers a comprehensive range of services. From design and planning to approvals, demolition, and construction, we provide a full-cycle restoration service to bring your vision to life. Let us help you restore your property to its best condition.

Hail Damage Restoration

Book Appointment Years Of Experience 0 + Satisfied Clients 0 + Projects completed 0 k+ Team Members 0 +

Our Process

Rapid Restore's hail damage restoration division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive repair and restoration of properties affected by hailstorms. Our expert team conducts thorough roof, siding, and window inspections to assess the extent of damage. Utilizing advanced repair techniques and high-quality materials, we meticulously restore individual shingles, replace damaged siding panels, and repair or replace broken windows. Our skilled technicians address issues such as granule loss, impact fractures, and dents, ensuring the restoration of the roof's protective barrier and the overall aesthetic appeal of the property.

We work closely with insurance adjusters to expedite the claims process and provide clients with exceptional customer service throughout the restoration journey.

Book Appointment

Why Work With Us?

Choosing the right partner for your home renovation is crucial, and we understand the significance of your decision. Here's why working with us is the best choice for your project:

Expert
craftsmanship

Rapid Restore's commitment to craftsmanship is evident in every project we undertake. Our skilled artisans and technicians possess a deep-rooted passion for their trade, utilizing time-honored techniques alongside the latest industry advancements. We take pride in delivering exceptional results that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring that every detail is meticulously executed with precision and care.

Customer-center
Approach

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional customer experiences throughout every stage of the project. We prioritize open communication, active listening, and understanding our clients' unique needs and preferences. By fostering strong relationships built on trust and reliability, we ensure that our clients feel valued and supported throughout the entire process.

Comprehensive
services

Rapid Restore offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. From initial consultations and project planning to expert execution and ongoing maintenance, we provide a seamless and integrated approach to ensure exceptional results. Our team possesses a wide range of expertise, allowing us to handle projects of varying complexity and scope. By offering a one-stop solution for multiple services, we streamline the project process, minimize inconvenience for our clients, and deliver exceptional value.

Excellent Value
Affordable services

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional value and affordability without compromising on quality. We offer competitive pricing, transparent cost estimates, and efficient project management to maximize the return on investment for our clients. Our team explores innovative cost-saving strategies and sources high-performance materials at optimal prices, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible value for their hard-earned money without sacrificing quality or functionality.

BOOK a FREE virtual CONSULTATION

Call 403 971-7984 BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Get In Touch

REQUEST A FREE PROJECT ESTIMATE

For an obligation-free consultation regarding your home renovation needs, please share your details with us using the contact form below. At Rapid Restore, our expert team, led by a commitment to "restoration with excellence," offers a comprehensive range of services. From design and planning to approvals, demolition, and construction, we provide a full-cycle restoration service to bring your vision to life. Let us help you restore your property to its best condition.

Our Process

Rapid Restore is your trusted partner for all your construction, renovation, and restoration needs in Calgary, Alberta. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service, quality craftsmanship, and timely project completion. Our team of skilled professionals is equipped to handle a wide range of projects, from minor repairs to major renovations.

Whether you’re dealing with the aftermath of a disaster or simply looking to improve your property, we’re here to help. Our focus on customer satisfaction ensures that your project is completed to the highest standards. With Rapid Restore, you can rest assured that your property is in good hands.

Book Appointment

Why Work With Us?

Choosing the right partner for your home renovation is crucial, and we understand the significance of your decision. Here's why working with us is the best choice for your project:

Expert
craftsmanship

Rapid Restore's commitment to craftsmanship is evident in every project we undertake. Our skilled artisans and technicians possess a deep-rooted passion for their trade, utilizing time-honored techniques alongside the latest industry advancements. We take pride in delivering exceptional results that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring that every detail is meticulously executed with precision and care.

Customer-center
Approach

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional customer experiences throughout every stage of the project. We prioritize open communication, active listening, and understanding our clients' unique needs and preferences. By fostering strong relationships built on trust and reliability, we ensure that our clients feel valued and supported throughout the entire process.

Comprehensive
services

Rapid Restore offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. From initial consultations and project planning to expert execution and ongoing maintenance, we provide a seamless and integrated approach to ensure exceptional results. Our team possesses a wide range of expertise, allowing us to handle projects of varying complexity and scope. By offering a one-stop solution for multiple services, we streamline the project process, minimize inconvenience for our clients, and deliver exceptional value.

Excellent Value
Affordable services

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional value and affordability without compromising on quality. We offer competitive pricing, transparent cost estimates, and efficient project management to maximize the return on investment for our clients. Our team explores innovative cost-saving strategies and sources high-performance materials at optimal prices, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible value for their hard-earned money without sacrificing quality or functionality.

BOOK a FREE virtual CONSULTATION

Call 403 971-7984 BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Get In Touch

REQUEST A FREE PROJECT ESTIMATE

For an obligation-free consultation regarding your home renovation needs, please share your details with us using the contact form below. At Rapid Restore, our expert team, led by a commitment to "restoration with excellence," offers a comprehensive range of services. From design and planning to approvals, demolition, and construction, we provide a full-cycle restoration service to bring your vision to life. Let us help you restore your property to its best condition.

We prioritize open communication, active listening, and understanding our clients' unique needs and preferences. By fostering strong relationships built on trust and reliability, we ensure that our clients feel valued and supported throughout the entire process.

Comprehensive
services

Rapid Restore offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. From initial consultations and project planning to expert execution and ongoing maintenance, we provide a seamless and integrated approach to ensure exceptional results. Our team possesses a wide range of expertise, allowing us to handle projects of varying complexity and scope. By offering a one-stop solution for multiple services, we streamline the project process, minimize inconvenience for our clients, and deliver exceptional value.

Excellent Value
Affordable services

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional value and affordability without compromising on quality. We offer competitive pricing, transparent cost estimates, and efficient project management to maximize the return on investment for our clients. Our team explores innovative cost-saving strategies and sources high-performance materials at optimal prices, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible value for their hard-earned money without sacrificing quality or functionality.

Welcome to

Rapid Restore

Rapid Restore is your trusted partner for all your construction, renovation, and restoration needs in Calgary, Alberta.

CALL NOW Years Of Experience 0 + Satisfied Clients 0 + Projects completed 0 k+ Team Members 0 +

Who We Are?

Rapid Restore is your trusted partner for all your construction, renovation, and restoration needs in Calgary, Alberta. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service, quality craftsmanship, and timely project completion. Our team of skilled professionals is equipped to handle a wide range of projects, from minor repairs to major renovations.

Whether you’re dealing with the aftermath of a disaster or simply looking to improve your property, we’re here to help. Our focus on customer satisfaction ensures that your project is completed to the highest standards. With Rapid Restore, you can rest assured that your property is in good hands.

Learn More

Our Services

Rapid Restore's services in Calgary, Alberta, are at the forefront of the industry, utilizing cutting-edge technologies and methodologies to deliver unparalleled results. Our team of highly skilled professionals possesses in-depth knowledge and expertise in a wide range of services, from complex structural repairs to intricate finish work. We employ advanced project management tools and quality control systems to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and client satisfaction. With a focus on continuous improvement and staying ahead of industry trends, Rapid Restore is committed to providing innovative and sustainable solutions that exceed our clients' expectations.

Fire Damage Restoration

Learn More Rapid Restore's fire damage restoration division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive restoration of properties affected by fire and smoke. Our team of certified technicians employs advanced cleaning and restoration techniques to mitigate structural damage, eliminate smoke odors, and salvage personal belongings. Learn More

Hail Damage Restoration

Learn More Rapid Restore's hail damage restoration division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive repair and restoration of properties affected by hailstorms. Our expert team conducts thorough roof, siding, and window inspections to assess the extent of damage. Learn More

Water Damage Restoration

Learn More Rapid Restore's hail damage restoration division in Calgary specializes in the comprehensive repair and restoration of properties affected by hailstorms. Our expert team conducts thorough roof, siding, and window inspections to assess the extent of damage. Learn More

Condominium Restoration

Residential Restoration

Learn More Rapid Restore is your trusted partner for all your construction, renovation, and restoration needs in Calgary, Alberta. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service, quality craftsmanship, and timely project completion. Learn More

Commercial Restoration

Learn More When disaster strikes your Calgary commercial property, Rapid Response Restoration is your trusted partner for swift and efficient restoration services. Our team of experienced professionals is dedicated to minimizing downtime and financial loss, restoring your business to its pre-loss condition. Learn More

Why Work With Us?

Choosing the right partner for your home renovation is crucial, and we understand the significance of your decision. Here's why working with us is the best choice for your project:

Expert
craftsmanship

Rapid Restore's commitment to craftsmanship is evident in every project we undertake. Our skilled artisans and technicians possess a deep-rooted passion for their trade, utilizing time-honored techniques alongside the latest industry advancements. We take pride in delivering exceptional results that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring that every detail is meticulously executed with precision and care.

Customer-center
Approach

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional customer experiences throughout every stage of the project. We prioritize open communication, active listening, and understanding our clients' unique needs and preferences. By fostering strong relationships built on trust and reliability, we ensure that our clients feel valued and supported throughout the entire process.

Comprehensive
services

Rapid Restore offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the diverse needs of our clients. From initial consultations and project planning to expert execution and ongoing maintenance, we provide a seamless and integrated approach to ensure exceptional results. Our team possesses a wide range of expertise, allowing us to handle projects of varying complexity and scope. By offering a one-stop solution for multiple services, we streamline the project process, minimize inconvenience for our clients, and deliver exceptional value.

Excellent Value
Affordable services

Rapid Restore is dedicated to providing exceptional value and affordability without compromising on quality. We offer competitive pricing, transparent cost estimates, and efficient project management to maximize the return on investment for our clients. Our team explores innovative cost-saving strategies and sources high-performance materials at optimal prices, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible value for their hard-earned money without sacrificing quality or functionality.

Call 403 971-7984 BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Our Vision

 

At Rapid Restore, we are committed to delivering top-tier construction and restoration services that go beyond our clients’ expectations. As a trusted name in the industry, we take pride in offering unmatched solutions for all your construction and restoration needs. Whether you’re building a new property, renovating an existing one, or restoring after a disaster, our team is here to guide you through the entire process. Thank you for choosing Rapid Restore – together, we’ll create a space that exceeds your vision.

CALL US NOW

Get Your Free Consultation

At our construction company, we understand that starting a construction project can be overwhelming. That’s why we offer a free consultation service to help ease your worries and guide you through the process.

book Appointment CALL US NOW

What Our Clients Are Saying?

"Exceptional service! We recently hired GTA Builds for a kitchen renovation, and the entire process exceeded our expectations. The team was professional, attentive to detail, and completed the project on time and within budget. Our new kitchen is not only stunning but also highly functional. I highly recommend GTA Builds for anyone looking for a reliable and skilled renovation service." Sarah M.View Project "We had a fantastic experience working with GTA Builds on our bathroom remodel. The team was communicative and transparent throughout the project, addressing any concerns promptly. The quality of workmanship is top-notch, and we are thrilled with the results. The only reason for not giving five stars is a minor delay, but overall, we would recommend GTA Builds for their professionalism and craftsmanship." John T.View Project "From the initial consultation to the final touches, GTA Builds demonstrated professionalism and expertise. They helped us turn our outdated living room into a modern, cozy space. The team was collaborative, offering insightful design suggestions while respecting our vision. The project was completed ahead of schedule, and we couldn't be happier with the outcome. Highly recommend!" Emily P. View Project "We hired GTA Builds for a complete home renovation, and it was a transformative experience. The team's attention to detail, creativity, and dedication were evident throughout the process. They seamlessly managed multiple aspects of the project, and the end result exceeded our expectations. Our home now feels like a personalized haven. Thank you, GTA Builds, for making our dream home a reality!" Michael H.View Project Previous Next

About Us

A Culture Of Quality Without Compromise

GTA Builds was founded in 2019 and registered builders located in Toronto, Canada. Over the past 2 years GTA has gone on to develop excellency in design, workmanship and customer service.

GTA Builds consistent success to its unwavering commitment to detail on each and every project it undertakes. This is achieved by limiting the number of projects it undertakes each year so that each and every client receives the best quality trades and the most personalized level of customer service possible.  

“We started GTA Builds in 2019 after working for the home improvement divisions of a couple of large project home builders in Toronto. We recognized the need for a company that specialized purely in alterations and additions and would prioritize quality and attention to detail over simply moving volume. We wanted to create a company with staff and tradespeople who take the time and care required to produce the best quality workmanship and overall experience possible for every client, every time. After all, you are trusting us to bring your dream into a reality, why should we give you anything less? Every project you take is personal to GTA Builds, for we build houses that you will make a home in, and that is why believe in quality over quantity.

  • Professional Specialist
  • Brilliant Ideas
  • Precise Builders
  • 24/7 Assiatance
Book Appointment 0 + Years Of Experience 0 + Satisfied Clients 0 k+ Projects completed 0 Years Warranty

Company Ethos

As every renovation project is unique, he believed that only the most experienced trades people capable of meeting the demands of individual design, should be recruited to work on his client’s homes. He also envisaged a building department run by the best and most experienced people available. The GTA team should share his passion for delivering the highest standards in the industry. From this vision the company philosophy was born…Quality Without Compromise.

Since its humble beginnings in 2019 GTA Build has become a well- known home renovation, home extensions and second storey additions builder in Ontario, Canada.

Today, 2 years later, Our philosophy remains unchanged in the GTA Build culture “We are very lucky to have found a team of people that not only share my passion for home improvements, but who are collectively and sincerely dedicated to Quality, Without Compromise. We build your young ones their childhood home here, a mother her nursery, a father his workshop. We don’t build houses here; we build homes where you will build your stories.

What We Offer?

FROM ELEGANT BATHROOMS TO WORLD CLASS KITCHENS, WE TAILOR TO YOUR BUDGET

No matter your budget or requirements you can trust GTA Builds to create a home renovation of the highest calibre, for a genuinely competitive fee. Below are just some of the ways you can work with Ontario’s most awarded home renovation team to improve your lifestyle

Kitchen Renovation

Learn More Transform your kitchen into the heart of your home with our expert renovation services. From contemporary designs to classic aesthetics, we specialize in crafting kitchens that blend functionality with style. Upgrade your countertops, cabinets, and appliances to create a space that not only meets your culinary needs but also reflects your unique taste.

Bathroom Renovation

Learn More Indulge in luxury and comfort with our bespoke bathroom renovation services. Whether it's a modern spa retreat or a timeless classic design, we cater to your preferences. From elegant fixtures to innovative storage solutions, we transform bathrooms into personal sanctuaries. Let us revitalize your space with expert craftsmanship and attention to detail.

Home Extension

Learn More Expand your living space with our home extension services. Whether you're looking to add a new room, extend the living area, or create a home office, we specialize in seamless integration. Our team ensures that the extension complements your existing architecture, providing a cohesive and functional addition to your home.

Basement Renovation

Learn More Unlock the potential of your basement with our renovation expertise. From cozy family spaces to stylish entertainment areas, we specialize in transforming basements into functional and inviting spaces. Maximize utility with creative designs, efficient lighting, and quality finishes, turning your basement into a valuable extension of your living space.

Whole House Renovation

Learn More Embark on a comprehensive home transformation with our whole house renovation services. We take a holistic approach, addressing every aspect of your home. From structural upgrades to interior design, our team ensures a cohesive and harmonious result. Elevate your entire living experience by entrusting your home's renovation to our skilled professionals

Painting

Learn More Revitalize your living spaces with our professional painting services. Whether you're looking to refresh the color palette, add accent walls, or completely transform the ambiance, our skilled painters bring creativity and precision to every project. From selecting the perfect hues to executing flawless finishes, we turn your vision into a vibrant reality. About Us

A Culture Of Quality Without Compromise

GTA Builds was founded in 2019 and registered builders located in Toronto, Canada. Over the past 2 years GTA has gone on to develop excellency in design, workmanship and customer service.

GTA Builds consistent success to its unwavering commitment to detail on each and every project it undertakes. This is achieved by limiting the number of projects it undertakes each year so that each and every client receives the best quality trades and the most personalized level of customer service possible.  

“We started GTA Builds in 2019 after working for the home improvement divisions of a couple of large project home builders in Toronto. We recognized the need for a company that specialized purely in alterations and additions and would prioritize quality and attention to detail over simply moving volume. We wanted to create a company with staff and tradespeople who take the time and care required to produce the best quality workmanship and overall experience possible for every client, every time. After all, you are trusting us to bring your dream into a reality, why should we give you anything less? Every project you take is personal to GTA Builds, for we build houses that you will make a home in, and that is why believe in quality over quantity.

From this vision the company philosophy was born…Quality Without Compromise.

Since its humble beginnings in 2019 GTA Build has become a well- known home renovation, home extensions and second storey additions builder in Ontario, Canada.

Today, 2 years later, Our philosophy remains unchanged in the GTA Build culture “We are very lucky to have found a team of people that not only share my passion for home improvements, but who are collectively and sincerely dedicated to Quality, Without Compromise. We build your young ones their childhood home here, a mother her nursery, a father his workshop. We don’t build houses here; we build homes where you will build your stories.

What We Offer?

FROM ELEGANT BATHROOMS TO WORLD CLASS KITCHENS, WE TAILOR TO YOUR BUDGET

No matter your budget or requirements you can trust GTA Builds to create a home renovation of the highest calibre, for a genuinely competitive fee. Below are just some of the ways you can work with Ontario’s most awarded home renovation team to improve your lifestyle

Learn More
Transform your kitchen into the heart of your home with our expert renovation services. From contemporary designs to classic aesthetics, we specialize in crafting kitchens that blend functionality with style. Upgrade your countertops, cabinets, and appliances to create a space that not only meets your culinary needs but also reflects your unique taste.

Bathroom Renovation

Learn More
Indulge in luxury and comfort with our bespoke bathroom renovation services. Whether it's a modern spa retreat or a timeless classic design, we cater to your preferences. From elegant fixtures to innovative storage solutions, we transform bathrooms into personal sanctuaries. Let us revitalize your space with expert craftsmanship and attention to detail.

Home Extension

Learn More
Expand your living space with our home extension services. Whether you're looking to add a new room, extend the living area, or create a home office, we specialize in seamless integration. Our team ensures that the extension complements your existing architecture, providing a cohesive and functional addition to your home.

Basement Renovation

Learn More
Unlock the potential of your basement with our renovation expertise. From cozy family spaces to stylish entertainment areas, we specialize in transforming basements into functional and inviting spaces. Maximize utility with creative designs, efficient lighting, and quality finishes, turning your basement into a valuable extension of your living space.

Whole House Renovation

Learn More
Embark on a comprehensive home transformation with our whole house renovation services. We take a holistic approach, addressing every aspect of your home. From structural upgrades to interior design, our team ensures a cohesive and harmonious result. Elevate your entire living experience by entrusting your home's renovation to our skilled professionals

Painting

Learn More
Revitalize your living spaces with our professional painting services. Whether you're looking to refresh the color palette, add accent walls, or completely transform the ambiance, our skilled painters bring creativity and precision to every project. From selecting the perfect hues to executing flawless finishes, we turn your vision into a vibrant reality.
